title: South Surrey Supportive Housing Plan Faces ALR Challenges

seo.Title: South Surrey Supportive Housing Plan Faces ALR Challenges
seo.Meta description: A proposed supportive housing project in South Surrey near 168 St. and 9 Ave. faces hurdles due to its proximity to the Agricultural Land Reserve. Supporters say it could still work with federal and provincial funding.
